directive: Zero-subscription CSV bank/card statement auditor that flags forgotten recurring SaaS charges and price hikes for solo founders ($9 one-time).

candidates.title: SubTrim — Zero-Plaid Local CSV Subscription & SaaS Leak Auditor
candidates.buyer_persona: Privacy-conscious solo founders, developers, and freelancers
candidates.recurring_pain: Refusing to hand over bank usernames/passwords/MFA to Plaid-connected budgeting apps ($14.99/mo YNAB/Monarch) while silently bleeding cash to forgotten recurring SaaS renewals and price hikes.
candidates.current_workaround: Manually eyeballing monthly PDF/CSV bank statements or skipping audits entirely
candidates.urgency_signal: Immediate cash savings plus strong security aversion to sharing bank credentials

evidence.verbatim_quote: Plaid needing you to enter your username, password, and MFA for your bank is like genuine lunacy.
Plaid requires your bank username and password, so they have full read-write access to your account. They can do anything you can do when logged in to the bank's website
unexpected charges and difficult-to-cancel billing is the game. The best customer is always the one that pays but never uses the service
